facts.statement: The type species of the genus Paralligator is Paralligator gradilifrons, described by Konzhukova in 1954.
Three species previously classified in the genus Shamosuchus are now considered synonyms of Paralligator.
facts.quote: synonyms: Shamosuchus tersus Efimov, 1983 Shamosuchus ulanicus Efimov, 1983 Shamosuchus ulgicus Efimov, 1981

facts.statement: Paralligator lived in Mongolia during the Late Cretaceous, between 96 and 70 million years ago.
facts.quote: Paralligator is an extinct genus of neosuchian crocodylomorph that lived during the Late Cretaceous (Cenomanian-Maastrichtian) period in what is now the Bayan Shireh and Nemegt formations of Mongolia, approximately 96 million to 70 million years ago.

facts.statement: The species Paralligator gradilifrons could grow up to 4 meters in length.
facts.quote: P. gradilifrons reached up to 4 m in length.

facts.statement: The braincase of Paralligator shows cerebral hemispheres that are roughly 2.5 times wider than the olfactory tract.
facts.quote: The cerebral hemispheres are the widest portions of the endocast of Paralligator; they are approximately 2.5 times wider than the olfactory tract and about 1.5 times wider than the midbrain and the portion corresponding to the medulla oblongata.

facts.statement: In 2015, Turner classified the species P. ancestralis as a junior synonym of P. gradilifrons.
facts.quote: Turner (2015) also referred P. ancestralis a junior subjective synonym of P. gradilifrons.

facts.statement: Paralligator belongs to the family Paralligatoridae.
Paralligator lived in the Gobi Desert of Mongolia during the Upper Cretaceous.
facts.quote: Paralligator es un género extinto de crocodilomorfo neosuquio paraligatórido, que vivió durante el Cretácico Superior, en el desierto de Gobi en Mongolia.

facts.statement: Paralligator's teeth were adapted to crush bivalves, gastropods, and other shelled or exoskeleton-bearing animals.
facts.quote: Sus dientes estaban adaptados para triturar bivalvos, gastrópodos y otros animales con concha o exoesqueleto.

facts.statement: Because its skull morphology does not suggest it was an ambush predator, researchers hypothesize its diet consisted of aquatic invertebrates.
facts.quote: Ya que su morfología craneana no indica que fuera un depredador de emboscada, ha llevado a considerar la idea de una dieta basada en invertebrados acuáticos.

facts.statement: Paralligator likely had to lift its entire head out of the water to breathe.
facts.quote: Paralligator probablemente habría tenido que elevar su cabeza por completo del agua para poder salir a respirar.

facts.statement: Fossil records indicate Paralligator lived from the Cenomanian to the Santonian stages, between 100.5 and 83.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Cenomanian to Santonian (100.5 to 83.6 million years ago)
